title: Stardew Valley farms go multiplayer
body: Three-player farms are working on our Stardew Valley server. Hosting, joining and playing together all succeed, with rejoin after disconnect, host leave and stale-seat cleanup verified on 7 September. Players sign in with their OpenPak identity: the server checks the token your console carries and reads your friend list through the account core, so invites work between linked accounts. The next step is an end-to-end run of that identity path on a linked console.
